title: Jubilant Chiapan Beans Burrito
description: A rich, aerated burrito that brings back nostalgic Chiapan flavors, featuring malt vinegar, leaf-wrap steam, and dairy-free-friendly ingredients.
instructions: Rinse and drain one cup of canned black beans.
Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Add 1 diced onion and 3 minced garlic cloves; sauté until translucent, about 3 minutes.
Stir in 1 teaspoon each of cumin and chili powder, a pinch of salt and pepper, and 1 tablespoon of malt vinegar; cook for 1 minute.
Add the beans and mix to coat; heat through for 4 minutes, then stir in 2 tablespoons of lime juice and 1/4 cup chopped cilantro.
Warm 6 large corn tortillas in a dry skillet or microwave for 30 seconds.
Spoon the bean mixture onto each tortilla and top with avocado slices.
Fold the tortilla into a burrito, wrap it in a banana leaf or parchment, and steam for 5 minutes to keep it moist.
Serve the burritos hot with a side of salsa or guacamole.
